svg.title: Three memory types
svg.desc: Working, episodic, and semantic memory side by side. Working memory is the scratchpad for the current turn, backed by the context window and gone when the turn ends. Episodic memory is the agent's autobiographical record of what happened across sessions, such as a task that failed on Friday with a given error, kept in an event store in time order. Semantic memory holds what is true, such as the fact that list.sort() is stable, in a durable knowledge base.
